subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new public per-agent-model generation timeout surface, or keep operators on existing provider/run timeout surfaces plus narrower thinking and repetition fixes?
rationale: The request adds a public config/default surface in provider routing and fallback behavior, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs that affect upgrades and existing model setups.

options.title: Define Per-Model Generation Timeout
options.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model generation budget with explicit precedence, fallback classification, schema/docs coverage, and focused tests.

options.title: Consolidate On Existing Timeouts
options.body: Decline the new key and improve documentation around provider request timeout, run timeout, first-event timeout, and idle watchdog behavior.

options.title: Split By Failure Mode
options.body: Leave generation timeout out of scope and route cloud-thinking stalls and repeated-output loops to their narrower canonical issues and PRs.

recommendation.title: Define Per-Model Generation Timeout
recommendation.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model generation budget with explicit precedence, fallback classification, schema/docs coverage, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already framed the public config decision on this issue and is the best discussion owner among the identified routing candidates.
